name: Task Assignment - Asked to Cover

name: Task Assignment - Now Covering
response:
{{ employee_name }} is on leave from {{ leave_from }}. This work is now on your list.

{% if items %}
    {% for item in items %}
  • {{ item }}
    • {% endfor %}
{% endif %}

Add notes on {{ handover }} as you go, so {{ employee_name }} can pick up where you left off.
subject: You are now covering for {{ employee_name }}

name: Task Assignment - Agreed
response:
Everyone you asked has agreed to cover your work during your leave ({{ leave_from }} to {{ leave_to }}).

Nothing moves until your leave starts. It all comes back to you on {{ return_date }}.
subject: Your handover has been agreed

name: Task Assignment - Declined
response:
Someone you asked to cover your leave ({{ leave_from }} to {{ leave_to }}) has declined: {{ reason }}

Open {{ handover }}, cancel it and amend it with someone else. Nothing has moved yet.
subject: A stand-in cannot cover your work

name: Task Assignment - Back Tomorrow
response:
{{ employee_name }} returns on {{ return_date }}, and what you are still covering goes back to them that morning.

Leave them a note on {{ handover }}: what you finished, what is waiting, and who called.
subject: {{ employee_name }} is back tomorrow

name: Task Assignment - Welcome Back
response:
Welcome back. Your work has been returned to your list.

{% if items %}
    {% for item in items %}
  • {{ item }}
    • {% endfor %}
{% endif %}{% if done_count %}

{{ done_count }} item(s) were finished while you were away; see the notes on {{ handover }}.

{% endif %}{% if has_note %}

Your stand-in left a note for you on {{ handover }}.

{% endif %}
subject: Welcome back: your work is on your list again

name: Task Assignment - Called Off
response: The leave {{ employee_name }} asked you to cover ({{ leave_from }} to {{ leave_to }}) has been withdrawn. Anything you were given has gone back to them.
subject: You no longer need to cover for {{ employee_name }}

name: Task Assignment - Prepare Your Handover
response:
Your leave starts on {{ leave_from }}, and nobody has been asked to cover your work yet.

Open your leave application and click Prepare Handover. It lists your open work, and you name who covers it.
subject: Hand over your work before your leave on {{ leave_from }}
